title: Platform Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)
description:
**Role Title:**
Platform Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)

**Department:**
Product Engineering

**Location:**
Mumbai / Pune (Onsite)

**Reports To:**
Engineering Manager

**Experience:**
5+ years, hiring across levels. Level is set by what you can own end to end, not by years on a resume.

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Scitara:**
Scitara is a global leader in digital transformation for scientific laboratories, enabling connectivity, automation, and data integrity across instruments, applications, and enterprise systems. Our cloud-based DLX platform is used by the world's top pharma, biotech, life sciences, and industrial R&D labs to modernize workflows and accelerate scientific outcomes. Lab informatics is growing 50 to 70% over the next five years, at the exact moment AI is being layered onto scientific data workflows. The software you build here decides how labs around the world adopt that wave.

**Role Summary:**
The DLX platform is a cloud-native, event-driven system of microservices that moves scientific data between instruments, lab applications, and enterprise systems, and increasingly runs AI agents over that data. It has a web UI, but most of the engineering is not web work: it is data processing, orchestration, integration, and backend connectivity in a distributed system. As a Platform Engineer you own features across that whole surface. One week that is a new orchestration capability in a NestJS service talking gRPC and Kafka; the next it is the React screens that expose it; the next it is an agent that acts on the data. You are a generalist by design, and you may bring a specialty on top of that.

**How Engineering Works Here:**
We are a small team with a large product. That shapes everything: You deliver features, not tickets. You get a goal and the context behind it. You work out the plan, the design, the tests, and the rollout. Nobody hands you a task list. AI is part of the job. We use agentic coding tools every day to design, generate, test, and document. You are expected to work this way and to be a sharp reviewer of what the tools produce. You own the result, not the tool. We are regulated. Our customers run validated GxP environments. Data integrity, traceability, and auditability are design constraints, not a checklist at the end. Thinkers and doers. The people who do well here notice problems, propose fixes, get them wrong sometimes, and get them right the next time. They bring ideas back to the team instead of waiting to be told.

**Key Outcomes (First 6 to 12 Months):**
Ship complete features into production: service, contract, data model, UI where needed, tests, documentation. Take a feature from a one-paragraph goal to a working plan and design without waiting for a task breakdown. Raise the quality of the services you touch: contracts, observability, test coverage, performance. Build or extend AI agent capabilities on the platform. Contribute to how the team uses agentic tooling: prompts, skills, review practices, automation. Senior / Lead: own the design of a platform capability end to end and set the bar for the engineers around you.

**Responsibilities:**
Responsibilities Design and build platform features across NestJS/Node.js microservices, gRPC contracts, Kafka event flows, MongoDB data models, and React UI. Build and integrate AI and agentic capabilities into the platform. Write code that meets the platform's data integrity and validation requirements. Use agentic development tools as the default way of working, and review their output critically. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies as a contributor, not an attendee. Troubleshoot production and integration issues across service boundaries. Senior / Lead: lead technical spikes and architecture decisions; mentor and raise engineering standards.

description:

**Step Into the World of Nicobar**

Nicobar is a modern, mindful, design-led brand from India. We are a human-centered digital brand with a growing retail presence across India. Our distinctive clothing, homeware, and jewelry blend global and local influences, designed to be loved and built to last.

Our style is clean, essential, and attainable. We care deeply about how our products are made and what goes into them. Founded in 2016, Nicobar has established itself as a premium brand known for its commitment to quality, simplicity, and design with a purpose.

We aim to inspire our consumer to embrace a modern, minimalist lifestyle—creating a modern Indian way of living, dressing, and looking at the world.

**About the Role**

As a
**Customer Retention Manager**
, you will own the retention engine at Nicobar—from lifecycle strategy and journey architecture to platform execution and performance analysis.

This is a
**hands-on execution role**
. You will build and optimise consumer journeys, configure flows, analyse cohort behaviour, run experiments, and work closely with technology and retail teams to create a connected online and offline consumer experience.

You will be expected to understand what the data is telling you, identify opportunities, and translate those insights into meaningful consumer journeys that drive retention and long-term consumer value.

**What You’ll Do**

**CRM Platform Ownership**

* Own and operate Nicobar’s CRM platform,
  **MoEngage**
  , as the internal CRM expert.
* Architect and maintain the CRM flow library, including journeys, triggers, suppression logic, and frequency caps.
* Own the event taxonomy and user attribute structure, identifying data gaps and working towards fixing them.
* Monitor platform-level performance including deliverability, list hygiene, segment overlap, and send-time distribution.
* Connect CRM platform behaviour with ecommerce data, including Shopify or equivalent platforms.
* Troubleshoot and optimise CRM journeys independently.

**Lifecycle & Journey Architecture**

* Design and execute the full consumer lifecycle across onboarding, conversion, engagement, win-back, and churn suppression.
* Build journeys with clear hypotheses, defined audiences, channel logic, and measurable success metrics.
* Develop and optimise key journeys such as:
* New user onboarding
* Power User frequency journeys
* Light-to-Power User conversion
* Win-back and churn prevention
* Omnichannel nudges connecting online customers with their nearest Nicobar store

**Experimentation & Optimisation**

* Design and run structured A/B tests and holdout-group experiments.
* Develop clear hypotheses, test them rigorously, interpret results, and iterate based on learnings.
* Evaluate whether results are statistically meaningful and use insights to continuously improve retention.

**Calendar Intelligence & Revenue Optimisation**

* Evaluate the CRM calendar by customer cohort—understanding who receives what, how frequently, and with what impact.
* Identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, and revenue without relying solely on offers and incentives.

**Omnichannel CRM**

* Help build a connected view of the consumer across online orders, in-store purchases, browsing behaviour, and channel history.
* Work closely with technology and retail operations to connect POS and in-store consumer signals with the CRM platform.
* Identify data gaps and proactively drive improvements.
* Build journeys that meaningfully move customers between digital and physical channels.

**Customer Engagement**

* Create post-purchase journeys that connect online buyers with their nearest Nicobar store.
* Build post-store-visit follow-ups that continue the customer relationship digitally.
* Create meaningful WhatsApp and SMS communication that feels personal and brand-led rather than like an automated broadcast.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Have strong hands-on experience with a CRM platform, particularly
  **MoEngage**
  .
* Have designed and executed omnichannel journeys connecting digital and physical customer experiences.
* Can independently interpret CRM and cohort data and translate insights into action.
* Have experience running lifecycle experiments with holdout groups and can demonstrate what you learned from them.
* Enjoy owning execution in an agile, fast-moving environment.
* Are comfortable working cross-functionally with technology, retail, ecommerce, and consumer experience teams.
* Have a strong consumer-centric and analytical mindset.
* Think beyond short-term conversions and understand the importance of long-term consumer retention and value.

**This Role May Not Be For You If...**

* Your CRM experience has primarily been strategy and briefing, with execution handled by another team.
* You rely heavily on a data or analytics team to interpret CRM performance.
* Your retention strategy is primarily driven by discounts, offers, and incentives.
* Your experience is limited to digital CRM and you haven't worked with offline customer data or physical retail environments.

**The Nicobar Spark**

**Customer First:**
We care about creating relevant, thoughtful experiences that build lasting relationships.

**Analytical & Curious:**
We look beyond surface-level metrics and ask what the data is really telling us.

**Hands-On & Ownership Driven:**
We believe in getting close to the work, solving problems, and owning outcomes.

**Systems Thinker:**
We build processes, journeys, and technology that make the customer experience better and the business stronger.

Why Nicobar?

If you’re excited by the intersection of
**customer behaviour, data, technology, creativity, and retention**
, this is an opportunity to build and shape Nicobar’s CRM and consumer retention engine.

Come help us build consumer relationships that go beyond the next transaction.

description:
**About UsSolutionsInsightsCareersContact Us**

Senior Product Designer
  
  
Own product design problems end to end on the DPDP Consent Manager: understanding the business and user problem, structuring the experience, prototyping and testing it, and delivering high-quality UI engineers can build from.

**Experience**
4+ years
  
  
Why this role
  
  
Whether a person understands what they are agreeing to is decided by design.
  
  
01
  
  
Real ownership of the experience, end to end
  
  
02
  
  
Consent has to be understood, not just recorded — that is the design problem
  
  
03
  
  
Withdrawal as easy as giving consent: Section 6(4), tested before launch
  
  
04
  
  
One accessible, multilingual design system across both products
  
  
The work
  
  
What you'll actually do
  
  
01
  
  
What you'll own
  
  

* The individual's app, on web and mobile — one place for a person to see who holds their data and on what basis, and to give, review or withdraw consent; it has to work for a first-time smartphone user and for a lawyer
* The organisation console — the tool DPOs, compliance and legal teams use every day: consent inventory, notices, rights requests, grievances and audit evidence; dense, fast and precise
* Notices and consent screens — turning legal notices into language people understand, in English and Indian languages, and designing the consent screens organisations embed in their own products
* The design system — one accessible, multilingual system across both products, built and maintained with frontend engineering
* Research, done by you — planning and running usability tests with synthetic data, because you will never see real users' data
* Quality through the build — working with Product and Engineering through every sprint, reviewing what is implemented, and cutting scope with them when the dates require it

02
  
  
The hard part
  
  

* Consent has to be understood, not just recorded — a consent a person did not understand is a compliance artefact and a moral failure at the same time; making a legal notice comprehensible, in plain language and across languages, is the design problem of the whole product
* Withdrawal has to be as easy as giving consent — the Act requires it (Section 6(4)): no pre-checked boxes, no dark patterns, no extra steps on the way out; we test these flows against exactly this before launch
* You cannot look at the data — personal data routed through the platform must not be readable by us; that is statutory, not a preference, so you will design flows you can never inspect and validate them through usability testing and synthetic data
* Nobody has done this — no Consent Manager is registered yet, so there is no direct incumbent to benchmark against; you design from the Act, the Rules and what people actually need
* The dates are not ours to move — scope is the only variable, and you will be cutting things you like

03
  
  
Minimum qualification
  
  

* 4 years of product design experience on digital products that shipped
* A portfolio with at least two end-to-end projects showing the problem, the flows, the prototypes, the final UI, what happened after launch and what you changed because of it
* Experience planning and running usability studies yourself, and changing a design because of what they showed
* Designing to WCAG 2.1 AA as a matter of course — contrast, focus order, screen-reader labels, touch targets, layouts that survive 200% zoom
* Writing interface text as carefully as you draw it — you can turn a dense legal or technical paragraph into plain language without changing what it means
* Expert Figma: components, variants, auto layout and tokens; you have built or substantially extended a design system that engineers shipped from
* Responsive design across web and mobile, with enough understanding of frontend constraints that engineers build your work rather than redesign it
* Practical use of AI tools in your design workflow — ideation, research synthesis, prototyping, UI generation or design-to-code — and a clear view of where they help and where they mislead

04
  
  
**Preferred**

* Experience as the first or only designer on a product, at a startup or inside a larger company
* Designing for Indian languages and scripts — text expansion, mixed scripts, line height and type that holds up in Devanagari, Bengali, Tamil and others
* Dense B2B or enterprise products: admin consoles, dashboards, audit trails, role-based access and long multi-step workflows
* Regulated domains such as fintech, KYC, insurance, health or privacy, especially consent, permission or account-aggregator flows
* Designing an AI feature — explaining a model's output to a user, or designing for uncertainty
* Prototyping in code (HTML/CSS or React) or with design-to-code tools
* A degree in Design, HCI, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, Computer Science or a related field — portfolio and practical experience carry more weight than where you studied

How we work
  
  

* Hybrid working style with anchor at our Grandthum office in Greater Noida, Tech Zone IV
* Defined core collaboration hours — outside that, flex your day around its natural shape
* Architecture decisions get written down and argued in the open. Small, reviewable changes. Depth is valued over volume
* Company-issued devices and approved tooling for anything touching customer or compliance data. Given what we build, we hold ourselves to the standard we sell

The practical details
  
  

* Location: Grandthum, Tech Zone IV, Greater Noida West, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
* Employment type: full-time
* Reports to: Product Manager

**ROLE PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:**

* Drive the end-to-end transformation of liabilities onboarding journeys across fully digital and assisted channels, with focus on journey design, process digitization, testing coordination, development execution, and API/integration readiness.
* Translate business and customer requirements into clear user journeys, process flows, BRDs, test scenarios, and implementation requirements for Savings Account, Current Account, Fixed Deposits, Video KYC, Video Banking, Video PD and other liability onboarding journeys.
* Work closely with Product Owner, technical teams, partner development teams, SIT/UAT teams and rollout teams to ensure timely sprint execution, defect resolution, testing closure, and smooth production deployment.

* Drive digital liabilities onboarding initiatives for Savings Account, Current Account, Fixed Deposits and allied journeys to improve acquisition, conversion and business throughput.
* Prepare and manage project plans, sprint requirements and delivery milestones for digital acquisition and assisted onboarding initiatives.
* Track onboarding funnel performance, TAT, drop-offs, conversion, adoption and productivity benefits to identify improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate with business and channel teams to enable usage, adoption and growth of digital liability onboarding platforms.

Educational Qualifications :

* Graduate / Postgraduate
* Engineering background is preferred

Experience:

* 10-12 Years of overall experience in BFSI
* Minimum 5 years’ experience in developing liability products, sales and marketing
* Minimum 3 years of experience in Project management, agile framework, writing user journeys etc.

title: Assistant Manager, Design & Creative
description:
**About us**

WeWork India is one of India’s leading flexible workspace operators – ‘Great Place To Work’ certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025), aimed at creating flexible workspace solutions for companies of all sizes.

Since its inception in India in 2016, WeWork India has expanded across 68 operational centres in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad. WeWork India meets distinct workspace needs, for various businesses. WeWork India strives to provide customised and curated solutions for various office space needs through its products and solutions.

At WeWork India, we’re driven by collaboration, creativity, and a shared vision to redefine the future of work. If you're looking to be part of a dynamic, fast-growing organisation that values talent and fosters growth, join us and build your future with WeWork India.

For more information, please visit our website

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Designer who aspires to grow into Art Direction, joining the Brand & Marketing team with a strong creative instinct, solid execution skills, and the ability to collaborate with internal teams, agencies, photographers, and other creative partners. The right candidate has design at their core, a sharp aesthetic sensibility, and a consistent premium output. They are passionate, excited by art direction, comfortable brainstorming, and able to execute at a level that inspires confidence.

Roles & Responsibilities

* Brand guidelines & systems: Develop, refine, and use WeWork India’s brand guidelines; create scalable design systems across projects and products; ensure brand consistency across digital, print, product, social, photography, event, and sales assets; elevate the brand through premium visual output.
* Building opening campaigns: Lead end-to-end campaign design for new building launches - from ideation to execution, across social, newspapers, billboards, website, digital media, sales collateral, events, and partnerships; deliver designs that are premium and differentiate WeWork from its competitors.
* Digital media: Ideate and execute assets for digital marketing channels to drive CTR, open rates, and performance benchmarks; across assets like static ads, carousels, GIFs, videos, emailers, and newsletters with a premium visual language that supports lead generation.
* Product campaigns: Brainstorm and build narrative-led product campaigns; translate storytelling into visual formats; collaborate with agencies for campaign films and cutdowns; ensure final outputs meet premium quality standards.
* Photography & videography: Work with photographers and videographers to produce high-quality image and video banks for building openings and product needs; maintain and deploy organized asset libraries for cross-team usage.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with marketing, events, technology, social media, sales, and community teams to deliver requirements; support in creating process for faster TATs and consistent quality across assets.
* Innovation: Drive creative innovation through new formats, ideas, and campaign approaches; proactively pitch concepts and challenge the status quo while maintaining a premium aesthetic and bringing forward out-of-the-box design.

Experience & QualificationsGraphic Design & Direction

* Strong fundamentals in brand guidelines, typography, layout, campaign films, and visual identity across print and digital.
* Proficiency in Adobe Suite (Mainly Illustrator, Indesign, Photoshop) and Figma. Bonus (good to have): motion graphics, editing skills, UI/UX.

* Experience working with photographers and videographers, creating photography guidelines, content libraries, and visual strategy.
* Experience with agencies and production houses to deliver film-led campaigns and premium storytelling. Understanding of performance media and digital marketing, and how to optimize assets across emailers, newsletters, ads (static + video), OOH, and CRM.

Project Management

* Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams, agencies, photographers, and videographers. Ability to manage multi-track campaign delivery across multiple products and stakeholders.
* Supports resource planning, pipeline tracking, and deliverable management for internal teams.
* Supports budgeting, invoicing, and procurement processes tied to creative output.
* Ability to work independently with structured communication, ownership, and accountability.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that  you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
**About Unosecur**
Unosecur is a fast-growing, Pre-Series A startup with $5M in funding. We're a B2B security SaaS platform making identity security smarter and simpler for enterprises worldwide, with sales teams across the USA, Europe, and India.
  
  
You'll be part of a diverse team working on cybersecurity and AI, with opportunities to solve complex problems and build production-grade AI capabilities.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re hiring a
**UI Developer**
based in Bengaluru to build intuitive, high-performance, and scalable user interfaces for Unosecur’s Identity Security platform.
  
  
You’ll work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to turn complex security workflows and large amounts of data into simple, seamless user experiences.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build production-grade interfaces. Develop and maintain modern web applications using JavaScript, React.js, Vite, and Zustand.
* Manage application state. Design and maintain scalable frontend state using Zustand, including stores, actions, selectors, and asynchronous workflows.
* Create reusable UI components. Build responsive, maintainable, and scalable frontend components.
* Turn designs into products. Translate designs, wireframes, and product requirements into polished user experiences.
* Integrate with backend systems. Work closely with backend engineers to integrate APIs and data-driven workflows.
* Own UI quality. Ensure consistency, responsiveness, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Optimize performance. Improve rendering, load times, state updates, and overall frontend performance.
* Collaborate closely. Work with Product, Design, and Engineering from requirements through implementation and release.

**What You’ll Need**

* Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript and modern frontend development.
* Strong experience building production applications using React.js.
* Hands-on experience with Zustand for state management.
* Experience designing frontend state using stores, selectors, actions, and asynchronous state updates.
* Experience working with Vite and modern frontend build tooling.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and component-based architecture.
* Experience integrating REST APIs and working with asynchronous data.
* Good understanding of React rendering, frontend performance, and browser fundamentals.
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to UI/UX detail.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Zustand middleware such as persistence and devtools.
* Experience building B2B SaaS or enterprise products.
* Experience building dashboards, complex workflows, tables, or data-heavy interfaces.
* Familiarity with design systems and reusable component libraries.
* Experience with cybersecurity, cloud, or identity products.
* Prior experience working in an early-stage or high-growth startup.

title: Visual & Motion Design Associate
description:
**Location:**

Bangalore, India

**Experience:**

1–2 years (Freshers with strong internship/apprenticeship experience and a solid portfolio are welcome to apply)

**About Tummoc**

‘Commute’ spelt backwards is Tummoc (well, minus the “e”). And that’s exactly what we’re here to do: reverse the declining use of public transport in urban India.

Tummoc is on a mission to transform how people globally commute by creating a seamless public transport experience. We integrate various modes of transport, including buses, metros, and trains, into a single intelligent mobility platform, helping millions travel smarter and greener.

**About the Role**

**We're looking for a Visual & Motion Design Associate**
